snippet.title: The Seventh Seal - Indie Horror Game - Trailer #4 (2026) Update
snippet.description:
The Seventh Seal is a narrative survival horror game where prophecy bleeds into reality. As the seals fracture, ancient forces claw their way back into the world — and you’re the only one who can decide what breaks next.

In this trailer, glimpse the corrupted world, the entities stalking the last survivors, and the choices that shape the final apocalypse.
